# Load packages used for the Shiny interface, sampling, and UI icons.
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(mvtnorm)
library(bsicons)

# Build the sidebar controls and tabs that display sampler diagnostics.
ui <- page_sidebar(fillable = TRUE,
  #Sidebar {{{
  sidebar = sidebar(open = "open", 
                    accordion(  
                      accordion_panel( #Model Parameters ) {{{
                        title = "Model Parameters",
                        icon = bsicons::bs_icon("menu-app"),
                        selectInput("model_type", "Model Type:",
                                    c("Gaussian (known var)" = "gaussian",
                                      "Binomial" = "binomial",
                                      "Beta" = "beta",
                                      "Gamma" = "gamma"),
                                    selected = 'gaussian'),    
                        sliderInput(
                          'num_data',
                          'Number of data observations (10^x):',
                          min = 0,
                          max = 4,
                          step = 0.1,
                          value = 1.0
                        ),
                        conditionalPanel( #Gaussian options ) {{{
                          condition = 'input.model_type=="gaussian"',
                          sliderInput(
                            'theta1_gaussian',
                            'Data mean x:',
                            min = -1.5,
                            max = 1.5,
                            step = 0.01,
                            value = 0.0
                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'theta2_gaussian',

                            min = -1.5,
                            max = 1.5,
                            step = 0.01,
                            value = 0.0
                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'stdev',

                            'Prior Range:',
                            min = 1,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 1,
                            value = c(1,10)
                          )
                        ),#}}}
                        conditionalPanel( #Beta options ) {{{
                          condition = 'input.model_type=="beta"',
                          sliderInput(

                          sliderInput(

                            max = 10,

                            'prior1_beta',

                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,

                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'prior2_beta',
                            'Prior Range Shape2:',
                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,
                            value = c(0,10)
                          )
                        ),#}}}
                        conditionalPanel( #Gamma options ) {{{
                          condition = 'input.model_type=="gamma"',
                          sliderInput(
                            'theta1_gamma',
                            'Shape:',
                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,
                            value = 7, 
                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'theta2_gamma',
                            'Rate:',
                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,
                            value = 2
                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'prior1_gamma',
                            'Prior Range Shape:',
                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,
                            value = c(0,10)
                          ),
                          sliderInput(
                            'prior2_gamma',
                            'Prior Range Rate:',
                            min = 0,
                            max = 10,
                            step = 0.1,
                            value = c(0,10)

                        selectInput("prior_type", "Prior Specification:",
                                    c("Uniform" = "uniform",
                                      "Gaussian" = "gaussian"),

                      ),  
                      #}}}
                      accordion_panel( #Sampler Parameters ) {{{
                        title = "Sampler Parameters",
                        icon = bsicons::bs_icon("sliders"),
                        selectInput("sampler", "Sampler Type:",
                                    c("Gibbs" = "gibbs",
                                      "Metropolis-Hastings" = "mh"),
                                    selected='mh'), 
                        sliderInput("prop_sd",
                                    withMathJax("Standard Deviation of proposal function:"),
                                    min = 0.01,
                                    max = 1.0,
                                    step=0.01,
                                    value = 0.2),
                        sliderInput("n_chain",
                                    withMathJax("Number of chains to run:"),
                                    min = 1,
                                    max = 8,
                                    step=1,
                                    value = 4),
                        sliderInput("n_samp",
                                    withMathJax("Number of samples in the chain ($10^{x}):"),
                                    min = 2,
                                    max = 4,
                                    step=0.1,
                                    value = 3),
                        sliderInput("n_burn",
                                    withMathJax("Number of burn-in samples to discard ($10^{x}$):"),
                                    min = 0,
                                    max = 3,
                                    step=0.1,
                                    value = 0),
                        sliderInput("step_thin",
                                    withMathJax("Number of steps between thinned samples:"),
                                    min = 1, 
                                    max = 30,
                                    step = 1, 
                                    value = 1),
                      ),  
                      #}}}
                      accordion_panel( #Figure Options ) {{{
                        title = "Figure Options",
                        icon = bsicons::bs_icon("bar-chart"),
                        checkboxInput("pstyle", "Lines instead of points?", TRUE),
                        checkboxInput("prior_vol", "Show prior volume?", TRUE),
                        sliderInput("annot_cex",
                                    expression("Annotation Scaling"),
                                    min = 0.5,
                                    max = 2.5,
                                    step = 0.1, 
                                    value = 1.5)
                      ),  
                      #}}}
                      id = "acc",  
                      open = NULL
                    ),
  ),#}}}
  #Main panel {{{
  tabsetPanel(tabPanel("Posterior",column("",plotOutput("plot", height="auto",width="auto", fill=TRUE),width=12)),
              tabPanel("Parameter Inference",column("",plotOutput("plot2", height="100%",width="100%", fill=TRUE),width=12)),
              tabPanel("Chain Sequence",column("",plotOutput("plot3", height="100%",width="100%", fill=TRUE),width=12)),
              tabPanel("Sample Correlation",column("",plotOutput("plot4", height="100%",width="100%", fill=TRUE),width=12))),
  #}}}
)

# Define reactive sampling logic and render the diagnostic plots.
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  
  observe({
    # Configure plot colours and select a proposal mechanism for the chosen sampler.
      palette(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3",
              "#FF7F00", "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999"))
    
    #Define the proposal function #{{{
    if (input$sampler=='mh') { 
      if (input$model_type!='binomial') { 
        #For MH & non-binomial: Multivariate Gaussian {{{
        propfun <- function(X) { 
          #Proposal function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler
          prop <- rmvnorm(1,X,input$prop_sd*diag(length(X)))
          return(prop)
        }
        #}}}
      } else { 
        #For MH with binomial: Gaussian + random-walk {{{
        propfun <- function(X) { 
          #Proposal function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler
          prop <- c(rnorm(1,X[1],input$prop_sd),sample(c(-1,0,1),size=1)+X[2])
          return(prop)
        }
      }
      #}}}
    } else { 
      #For Gibbs: conditional distributions {{{
      propfun <- function(X) { 
        #Proposal function for the gibbs sampler
        Xp <- rnorm(1, data[2] + input$rho*(X[2]  - data[2]), sqrt(1 - input$rho^2))
        Yp <- rnorm(1, data[1] + input$rho*(Xp - data[1]), sqrt(1 - input$rho^2))
        return(c(Xp,Yp))
      }
      #}}}
    }
    #}}}
    # Define the log-likelihood function for the selected model {{{
    theta1<-input[[paste0("theta1_",input$model_type)]]
    theta2<-input[[paste0("theta2_",input$model_type)]]
    prior1<-input[[paste0("prior1_",input$model_type)]]
    prior2<-input[[paste0("prior2_",input$model_type)]]
    if (input$model_type=='gaussian') {  
      #Set plot limits {{{
      xlim<-c(-5,5)
      ylim<-c(-5,5)
      #}}}
      #Gaussian data {{{
      observed_data <- rmvnorm(round(10^input$num_data),mean=c(theta1, theta2),
                               sigma=input$stdev^2*matrix(c(1,input$rho,input$rho,1), nrow=2))
      #}}}
      #Log-likelihood function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler: gaussian {{{
      loglikefun<-function(X) { 
        return(sum(dmvnorm(observed_data, mean=X,
                           sigma=input$stdev^2*matrix(c(1,input$rho,input$rho,1),nrow=2),
                           log=TRUE)))
      }
      #}}}
    } else if (input$model_type=='binomial') {  
      #Set plot limits {{{
      xlim<-c(-0.2,1.2)
      ylim<-c(0,11)
      #}}}
      #Binomial data {{{
      observed_data <- rbinom(10^input$num_data,prob=theta1, size=theta2)
      #}}}
      #Log-likelihood function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler: Binomial {{{
      loglikefun<-function(X) { 
        vals<-dbinom(observed_data,prob=X[1],size=round(X[2]),log=TRUE)
        #if (any(is.na(vals))) stop(paste0("invalid parameters:",paste(X,collapse=' ')))
        return(sum(dbinom(observed_data,prob=X[1],size=X[2],log=TRUE)))
      }
      #}}}
    } else if (input$model_type=='beta') {  
      #Set plot limits {{{
      xlim<-c(-1,11)
      ylim<-c(-1,11)
      #}}}
      #Beta data {{{
      observed_data <- rbeta(10^input$num_data,shape1=theta1, shape2=theta2)
      #}}}
      #Log-likelihood function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler: Beta {{{
      loglikefun<-function(X) { 
        return(sum(dbeta(observed_data,shape1=X[1],shape2=X[2],log=TRUE)))
      }
      #}}}
    } else if (input$model_type=='gamma') {  
      #Set plot limits {{{
      xlim<-c(-1,11)
      ylim<-c(-1,11)
      #}}}
      #Gamma data {{{
      observed_data <- rgamma(10^input$num_data,shape=theta1, rate=theta2)
      #}}}
      #Posterior function for the Metropolis-Hastings sampler: Gamma {{{
      loglikefun<-function(X) { 
        return(sum(dgamma(observed_data,shape=X[1],rate=X[2],log=TRUE)))
      }
      #}}}
    } else { 
      stop("Unimplemented model")
    }
    #}}}
    #Define the prior function {{{
    if (input$prior_type=='uniform') { #{{{
      priorfun<-function(X) { 
        if (all(X >= c(prior1[1],prior2[1])) && 
            all(X <= c(prior1[2],prior2[2]))) {
          return(1)
        } else { 
          return(0)
        }
      }
      #}}}
    } else { 
      stop("Unimplemented prior type")
    }
    #}}}
    # Define the posterior function {{{
    logpostfun<-function(X) { 
      return(loglikefun(X)+log(priorfun(X)))
    }
    # }}}
    #Define the sampler {{{
    # Implement a generic Metropolis-Hastings chain using the selected proposal and posterior {{{
    MH<-function(n,start,data) { 
      #Initialise the variables
      X<-matrix(NA,ncol=length(start),nrow=n)
      X[1,]<-start
      #Loop over our iterations 
      for (i in 2:n) { 
        #Generate a proposal point
        prop<-propfun(X[i-1,])
        # Compare on the log scale to avoid overflow in the acceptance ratio.
        accept <- logpostfun(prop) - logpostfun(X[i-1,])
        if (is.na(accept)) { 
          accept <- -Inf
        }
        u <- log(runif(1))
        #Test the acceptance criteria
        if (u<accept) { 
          #Accept the new data point
          X[i,]<-prop
        } else { 
          X[i,]<-X[i-1,]
        }
      }
      return(X)
    }
    #}}}
    # Create a Gibbs sampler for supported models, or use Metropolis-Hastings {{{
    if (input$sampler=='gibbs') {
      #Gibbs sampler: {{{
      observed_data<-colMeans(observed_data)
      if (input$model_type=='gaussian') { 
        #Gibbs Sampler with Gaussian likelihood {{{
        Gibbs<-function(start,n=1e3,data=c(0.0,0.0)) {
          #Initialise the variables 
          X<-Y<-rep(NA,n)
          #Enter the initial guesses 
          X[1]<-start[1]
          Y[1]<-start[2]
          #Loop over the next n steps
          for (i in 2:n) { 
            #Generate the sample for X
            X[i]<-rnorm(1,data[2]+input$rho*(Y[i-1]-data[2]),sqrt(1-input$rho^2))
            Y[i]<-rnorm(1,data[1]+input$rho*(X[i]-data[1]),sqrt(1-input$rho^2))
          }
          return(cbind(X,Y))
        }
        sampler<-Gibbs
        #}}}
      } else { 
        stop(paste("model",input$model_type,"not yet implemented for gibbs")) 
      }
      #}}}
    } else if (input$sampler=='mh') { 
      #Metropolis-Hastings {{{
      sampler<-MH 
      #}}}
    } else { 
      stop(paste("sampler",input$sampler,"not yet implemented")) 
    }
    #}}}
    #}}}
    
    # Generate reproducible starting points and run the requested number of chains {{{
    set.seed(666)
    starts<-cbind(runif(input$n_chain,min=prior1[1],max=prior1[2]),
                  runif(input$n_chain,min=prior2[1],max=prior2[2]))
    if (input$model_type=='binomial') { 
      starts[,2]<-round(starts[,2])
    }
    #}}}
    #Construct the Samples {{{
    samps<-{}
    for (j in 1:nrow(starts)) 
      samps[[j]]<-sampler(start=unlist(starts[j,]),n=10^input$n_samp,data=observed_data)
    #}}}
    
    colours<-c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3",
               "#FF7F00", "#FFFF33", "#A65628", "#F781BF", "#999999")
    # Plot1: Render the joint posterior samples, marking burn-in separately from retained draws {{{
    output$plot <- renderImage({
      img<-htmltools::capturePlot({
        #Initialise the plot
        par(mar = c(4.1, 4.5, 1, 1))
        
        #Plot the samples 
        plot(starts,type='p',xlab=expression(theta[1]),ylab=expression(theta[2]),family='serif',
                           xlim=xlim,ylim=ylim,lwd=2,cex=2,cex.lab=input$annot_cex,cex.axis=input$annot_cex,tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          polygon(x=c(prior1[1], prior1[2], prior1[2], prior1[1]),
                  y=c(prior2[1], prior2[1], prior2[2], prior2[2]),
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha('grey',0.3),border=NA)
        }
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)){ 
          if (input$pstyle==TRUE) {
            if (round(10^input$n_burn)-1>0) { 
              lines(samps[[i]][1:(round(10^input$n_burn)-1),],lty=1,lwd=2,
                    col=seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.2)
              )
            }
            lines(samps[[i]][seq(round(10^input$n_burn),round(10^input$n_samp),by=input$step_thin),],lty=1,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.2)
            )
          } else {
            points(samps[[i]],lty=1,lwd=2,pch=20,cex=0.5,
                   col=c(rep(seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.2),10^input$n_burn),
                         rep(seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.2),10^input$n_samp-10^input$n_burn))
            )
          }
        }
        points(theta1,theta2,pch='+',cex=4,col='red')
      }, width=600,height=600)
      list(src = img)
    }, deleteFile = TRUE)
    #}}}
    # Plot2: Render the parameter-inference view of the sampled posterior {{{
    output$plot2 <- renderImage({
      img<-htmltools::capturePlot({
        #Initialise the plot
        layout(c(1,2))
        par(mar = c(4.1, 4.5, 1, 1))
        
        #Theta1
        #Construct the variable samples 
        plot_samp<-NULL
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)) { 
          plot_samp<-c(plot_samp,samps[[i]][seq(10^input$n_burn,10^input$n_samp,by=input$step_thin),1])
        } 
        #Plot the samples 
        plot(density(plot_samp,bw=input$prop_sd/sqrt(12),kern='rect'),type='l',xlab=expression(theta[1]),ylab=expression(Density),family='serif',
                           xlim=xlim,lwd=2,cex=2,cex.lab=input$annot_cex,cex.axis=input$annot_cex,main='',tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(v=prior1,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        abline(v=theta1,lty=2,col='blue',lwd=2)

        #Theta2 
        #Construct the variable samples 
        plot_samp<-NULL
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)) { 
          plot_samp<-c(plot_samp,samps[[i]][seq(10^input$n_burn,10^input$n_samp,by=input$step_thin),2])
        } 
        #Plot the samples 
        plot(density(plot_samp,bw=input$prop_sd/sqrt(12),kern='rect'),type='l',xlab=expression(theta[2]),ylab=expression(Density),family='serif',
                           xlim=ylim,lwd=2,cex=2,cex.lab=input$annot_cex,cex.axis=input$annot_cex,main="",tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(v=prior2,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        abline(v=theta2,lty=2,col='blue',lwd=2)
      }, width=600,height=600)
      list(src = img)
    }, deleteFile = TRUE)
    #}}}
    # Plot3: Render trace plots for each parameter to show chain progression and mixing. {{{
    output$plot3 <- renderImage({
      img<-htmltools::capturePlot({
        #Initialise the plot
        layout(c(1,2))
        par(mar = c(4.1, 4.5, 1, 1))
        
        #Theta1
        #Plot the samples 
        plot.new()
        plot.window(xlim=c(1,10^input$n_samp),ylim=xlim,log='x')
        box(lwd=1.5,col='black')
        mtext(side=1,text="Step Number",line=2.5,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        mtext(side=2,text=expression(theta[1]),line=2.0,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        axis(side=1,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=2,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=3,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=4,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(h=prior1,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)){ 
          if (input$pstyle==TRUE) {
            if (input$n_burn>0) {
              lines(1:(10^input$n_burn-1),samps[[i]][1:(10^input$n_burn-1),1],lty=1,lwd=2,
                    col=seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.5)
              )
            }
            lines((10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),samps[[i]][(10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),1],lty=1,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          } else {
            points(1:(10^input$n_samp),samps[[i]][,1],lty=1,lwd=2,pch=20,cex=0.5,
                   col=c(rep(seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.5),10^input$n_burn),
                         rep(seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5),10^input$n_samp-10^input$n_burn))
            )
          }
        }
        #Theta2
        plot.new()
        plot.window(xlim=c(1,10^input$n_samp),ylim=ylim,log='x')
        box(lwd=1.5,col='black')
        mtext(side=1,text="Step Number",line=2.5,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        mtext(side=2,text=expression(theta[2]),line=2.0,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        axis(side=1,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=2,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=3,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=4,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(h=prior2,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)){ 
          if (input$pstyle==TRUE) {
            if (input$n_burn>0) {
              lines(1:(10^input$n_burn-1),samps[[i]][1:(10^input$n_burn-1),2],lty=1,lwd=2,
                    col=seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.5)
              )
            }
            lines((10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),samps[[i]][(10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),2],lty=1,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          } else {
            points(1:(10^input$n_samp),samps[[i]][,2],lty=1,lwd=2,pch=20,cex=0.5,
                   col=c(rep(seqinr::col2alpha('black',0.5),10^input$n_burn),
                         rep(seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5),10^input$n_samp-10^input$n_burn))
            )
          }
        }
      }, width=600,height=600)
      list(src = img)
    }, deleteFile = TRUE)
    #}}}
    # Plot4: Render the sampled parameter-pair relationship across all chains {{{
    output$plot4 <- renderImage({
      img<-htmltools::capturePlot({
        #Initialise the plot
        layout(c(1,2))
        par(mar = c(4.1, 4.5, 1, 1))
        
        #Theta1
        #Plot the samples 
        plot.new()
        plot.window(xlim=prior1,ylim=prior1)
        box(lwd=1.5,col='black')
        mtext(side=1,text=expression(theta[1]^{i+1}),line=2.5,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        mtext(side=2,text=expression(theta[1]^{i}),line=2.0,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        axis(side=1,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=2,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=3,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=4,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(h=prior1,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)){ 
          plot_samp<-samps[[i]][(10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),1]
          plot_samp<-plot_samp[seq(1,length(plot_samp),by=input$step_thin)]
          if (input$pstyle==TRUE) {
            lines(plot_samp[1:(length(plot_samp)-1)],
                  plot_samp[2:(length(plot_samp))],
                  lty=1,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          } else {
            points(plot_samp[1:(length(plot_samp)-1)],
                  plot_samp[2:(length(plot_samp))],
                  pch=20,cex=0.5,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          }
        }
        #Theta2
        #Plot the samples 
        plot.new()
        plot.window(xlim=prior2,ylim=prior2)
        box(lwd=1.5,col='black')
        mtext(side=1,text=expression(theta[2]^{i+1}),line=2.5,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        mtext(side=2,text=expression(theta[2]^{i}),line=2.0,cex=input$annot_cex,family='serif')
        axis(side=1,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=2,labels=T,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=3,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        axis(side=4,labels=F,tcl=0.5)
        if (input$prior_vol) {
          abline(h=prior2,col='grey',lwd=2)
        }
        for (i in 1:nrow(starts)){ 
          plot_samp<-samps[[i]][(10^input$n_burn):(10^input$n_samp),2]
          plot_samp<-plot_samp[seq(1,length(plot_samp),by=input$step_thin)]
          if (input$pstyle==TRUE) {
            lines(plot_samp[1:(length(plot_samp)-1)],
                  plot_samp[2:(length(plot_samp))],
                  lty=1,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          } else {
            points(plot_samp[1:(length(plot_samp)-1)],
                  plot_samp[2:(length(plot_samp))],
                  pch=20,cex=0.5,lwd=2,
                  col=seqinr::col2alpha(colours[i],0.5)
            )
          }
        }
      }, width=600,height=600)
      list(src = img)
    }, deleteFile = TRUE)
    #}}}
  
  })
  
}

# Launch the Shiny application with the defined UI and server.
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
